parole.testo: Learned borrowing from Latin lentīgo. Earliest attestation as Late Middle English lentigines (plural).

parole.significato: Mother.
parole.testo: From Latin māter (“mother”), partly via Late Middle English matere. Doublet of mata and mother. Ancestor of matrix.

parole.significato: Someone who moderates.

parole.testo: From Latin sēminārium, from sēmen (“seed”). Compare seminar. In the ground sense, from Middle English semynair, semynary.
